nodes.label: WebSocket Real-Time Sync
nodes.rationale: Used for instant playlist updates across all connected screens without requiring page refresh

nodes.label: HTTP Polling Fallback
nodes.rationale: Provides reliability when WebSocket connections fail, ensuring ads continue to play

nodes.label: AI Content Moderation
nodes.rationale: Auto-approves uploaded videos after simulated analysis; production would use AWS Rekognition

nodes.label: Dynamic Platform Pricing
nodes.rationale: Pricing varies by footfall (very-high, high, medium, low) and prime time slots

nodes.label: IST Timezone Conversion
nodes.rationale: Server converts UTC to IST (UTC+5:30) for booking slot matching since all bookings use IST

nodes.label: Fallback Playlist Strategy
nodes.rationale: When no active bookings, shows approved/scheduled ads for that specific platform only to prevent cross-platform leakage

nodes.label: Ad Rotation System
nodes.rationale: Multiple ads rotate in a time slot with equal display time; next ad plays after current duration
